title: Advisory & Treatment Plan
subtitle: Integrated Pest Management (IPM) guidelines compliant with Indian agricultural safety standards
morningOrEvening: Spray during cool morning (7-10 AM) or late afternoon (4-6 PM)
wearMask: Always wear face mask, gloves, and protective boots during chemical spraying.
neemOil: Neem Oil 10,000 PPM @ 2-3 ml per liter of water with soap surfactant.
trichoderma: Trichoderma viride bio-fungicide soil drenching @ 5 kg / acre.
copperOxychloride: Copper Oxychloride 50 WP @ 2.5 g / liter of water.
mancozeb: Mancozeb 75 WP @ 2 g / liter of water.
